query:
-- Already enrolled in camp
SELECT cr.email, CONCAT(cr.parentFirstName, ' ', cr.parentLastName) as name, cr.camper1Name as kidName, 'Already enrolled in camp' as reason
FROM campRegistrations cr
WHERE cr.email IS NOT NULL AND cr.email != ''

UNION ALL

-- Already sent summer_camp_nurture sequence (completed)
SELECT l.email, l.parentName as name, l.kidName, 'Already completed nurture sequence' as reason
FROM leads l
INNER JOIN leadSequenceQueue lsq ON lsq.leadId = l.id
WHERE lsq.sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND lsq.status = 'sent'
  AND l.email IS NOT NULL AND l.email != ''

UNION ALL

-- Currently in the queue (pending/scheduled)
SELECT l.email, l.parentName as name, l.kidName, 'Already queued in nurture sequence' as reason
FROM leads l
INNER JOIN leadSequenceQueue lsq ON lsq.leadId = l.id
WHERE lsq.sequenceKey = 'summer_camp_nurture'
  AND lsq.status IN ('pending', 'scheduled')
  AND l.email IS NOT NULL AND l.email != ''

ORDER BY reason, name;
